harvest.source: git log --all feat commits at/after fork point 74886f7d5 (31 commits)

candidates.signal: CVM/breach wired into the agent loop (123ad6ef9) has no TUI visibility. /settings carries defense-watcher but nothing shows the live RunStrategy (recover|verify|challenge|pause|continue), even though computeSensorium runs every turn and saveCvmSnapshot persists each result
candidates.proposal: add a read-only /settings row (or status line) showing the current RunStrategy and the sensorium dims that drove it
candidates.caveat: read-only, never a control: CVM owns cognition only, the Gateway owns permission (§16); a toggle here would imply the operator can widen authority from the TUI

candidates.signal: MCP bridge (c5f97a25e, kernel/src/host/mcp-bridge.ts) has zero operator surface — the only coding-agent hit for 'mcp' is a comment
candidates.proposal: add a read-only bridge-status row: connected / endpoint / tool count
candidates.caveat: status only; never expose arbitrary endpoint entry from the TUI (that is a scope-surface change, not a settings row)

candidates.signal: sandbox Docker executor (8331108e2, helmpi-tools/src/sandbox.ts) has no surface
candidates.reason: buffer: the executor is chosen by Spec/tool, not switched mid-run. A settings row would promote an implementation detail to operator config, and the UI switch would need a matching authority path that does not exist

candidates.signal: CAI four-layer injection defense (2bc135312, kernel/src/guard/cai.ts, reached via runtime/gateway.ts) has no surface
candidates.reason: buffer: a security mechanism must not be operator-disableable from a settings panel; the toggle would hand any prompt-injection payload a documented path to switch off its own detector

candidates.signal: SARIF export (2b24d9b5c), supervise/escalation (35d94d64d), playbook coverage (7f2956654), spec engagement (458b220f9) are CLI-only
candidates.reason: buffer: all four are post-hoc or pre-run actions (report export, acceptance audit, coverage review, spec freeze). The TUI is a run-time surface; moving post-run queries into it adds no capability and splits one workflow across two places. Spec is deliberately frozen before a run (handoff §0.1) — a TUI editor for it would break the evidence chain

candidates.signal: tool-memory (0f0e307ad) is doctor-only; its runtime state (which probes are stale, which verdicts are unknown) is invisible during a run
candidates.proposal: add a read-only stale-probe count row
candidates.caveat: status only; the probe action itself stays in `helm doctor`
